title: Open a Topic the Platform Way
description:
**SITUATION:**

This is your first lab on the **KRaft** cluster — combined broker + controller, no ZooKeeper. (Lab 1 was the classic ZooKeeper control plane. You need both pictures.)

QuickBite already runs `orders`, `rider.dispatch`, and `restaurant.notifications` on the three-broker POC. Leave them alone.

The next need is `order.status`. An order keeps changing after it is placed: preparation, pickup, delivery. Customers, riders, and support all need those events in one ordered place. `order.status` will hold one event per status change, keyed by Order ID.

A ticket under `~/ticket/` proposes a shape. Treat it as a **claim**. The platform note under `~/ticket/PLATFORM.md` is the QuickBite standard.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Open the **Guide**. Confirm this cluster is KRaft (no ZooKeeper host).
2. Create `order.status` to the **platform** shape — not the ticket template if they disagree.
3. Do not change `orders`, `rider.dispatch`, or `restaurant.notifications`.
4. Fill every Investigation field, then Submit.

**SPEC:**

- `order.status`: 6 partitions, RF 3, `retention.ms` `259200000` (3 days), `min.insync.replicas` 2, `cleanup.policy` `delete`, ISR 3 on every partition.
- Live topics stay as you found them (`orders` / `rider.dispatch`: 6 parts; `restaurant.notifications`: 3 parts; RF 3; min.ISR 2; retention 7d; cleanup delete).

hints: BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS is set. kafka-topics.sh --create takes --partitions and --replication-factor; retention and min.insync.replicas are --config.
There is no ZooKeeper on this lab — do not look for zookeeper-shell or /controller znodes.
Fill the Investigation tab — missing answers fail on Submit.

problemStatement.guide:
# QuickBite Data Platform — open a topic the platform way (KRaft)

This lab is **KRaft**. Each `kafka-*` host is broker **and** controller. There is **no** ZooKeeper pod and no `/controller` znode.

| Host      | Role                                      |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------|
| `kafka-0` | Combined broker + controller (node id 1)  |
| `kafka-1` | Combined broker + controller (node id 2)  |
| `kafka-2` | Combined broker + controller (node id 3)  |
| `shell`   | CLI (`BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS`)                 |

Leave `orders`, `rider.dispatch`, and `restaurant.notifications` alone.

## 1. Read the ticket — then the platform note

```bash
less ~/ticket/TICKET.md
less ~/ticket/PLATFORM.md
```

The ticket can be wrong. **PLATFORM.md** is the QuickBite shape for `order.status`.

## 2. Create `order.status`

From the **shell**:

```bash
kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" --create \
  --topic order.status \
  --partitions 6 \
  --replication-factor 3 \
  --config retention.ms=259200000 \
  --config min.insync.replicas=2 \
  --config cleanup.policy=delete
```

Confirm:

```bash
kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" --describe --topic order.status
kafka-configs.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" \
  --describe --entity-type topics --entity-name order.status --all
```

Every partition should show three replicas in the ISR.

## 3. Prove you did not touch the live topics

```bash
kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" --describe --topic orders
kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" --describe --topic rider.dispatch
kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server "$BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS" --describe --topic restaurant.notifications
```

## 4. Investigation

Record that this control plane is KRaft, that you followed the platform note (not the wrong ticket), and the shape numbers you applied. Then Submit.
